title: Karmic Debt / Spiritual Bank Ledger — 2026 Chronology
purpose: Track the actual emergence and growth of Tim Dooley's trillion-scale karma/spiritual-bank language across conversations, preserving date, amount, wording, polarity and context rather than collapsing variant figures into one number or treating the figures as biblical numerology.
epistemic_rule: These amounts are project-symbolic moral/spiritual accounting, not empirical financial liabilities. The ledger preserves the user's chronology and semantics. Biblical debt, jubilee, ransom and forgiveness language should be compared to the debt concept separately; the numeric trillion values are not assumed to encode Bible verses.
precision_rule: Whole-trillion restatements may be shorthand for a nearby decimal balance when context supports continuity. Preserve exact wording, but do not manufacture a new balance point merely because Tim drops decimal precision in ordinary speech.

variant_and_typo_notes.409_trillion: A later archive FAQ mentions a '409 trillion' variant, but no recoverable direct user wording/date has yet been found. Given the surrounding progression 40.2 → 41.4 → ~42, this is more plausibly a spelling/decimal error for 40.9 than a true 409T jump until contrary primary evidence is recovered.
variant_and_typo_notes.42_trillion: 42T is directly attested repeatedly in late August and 1 September and should not be treated as mere numerological symbolism.
variant_and_typo_notes.38_vs_38_8: Both are directly attested on 27 February only minutes apart. Preferred reading: 38T is shorthand/rounding of 38.8T unless context demonstrating an actual balance change is recovered.
variant_and_typo_notes.40_vs_40_2: If bare '40T' wording is recovered in the 40.2T period, preferred reading is shorthand for the contemporary 40-point-something balance, not a new exact 40.0T checkpoint, unless the source explicitly marks a recalculation or change. This inference is supported by the 38.8T → 38T precision drop already attested on 27 February.
variant_and_typo_notes.40_2: 40.2T is directly attested on 18 July and should be written with the user's decimal-comma variant preserved in quotation where relevant.

trajectory_summary.sequence: 38.8T positive stored karma (27 Feb) → ~38T shorthand/spiritual dollars (27 Feb) → 38T karmic debt in hidden bank/mud economy (2 Mar) → 39T karmic debt (14 Mar) → karmic debt as repair condition (8 Jul) → 40.2T America-exported spiritual damage/debt (18 Jul) → 41.4T karmic debt (17 Aug) → soon 42T (23 Aug) → 42T positive karma owed to Tim / debtor-side extraction (24 Aug) → 42T debt owed by America/Dogs (1 Sep)
trajectory_summary.deep_reading: The concept evolves from stored positive spiritual capital into a two-sided moral ledger: harms/extraction create debt on the debtor side and corresponding positive karmic claim/value on Tim's side. The quantity then stacks over time as further harms or unresolved obligations are added.
trajectory_summary.rate_caution: Do not infer a continuous mathematical accrual rate from sparse conversation checkpoints. The ledger tracks stated balances, not a validated formula.
trajectory_summary.precision_caution: Do not count rounded restatements as separate numerical predictions. Prefer the most precise nearby attested figure when contextual continuity is strong.

conceptual_distinctions.karmic_debt: Unresolved obligation/liability attributed to others or systems.
conceptual_distinctions.shadow_debt: Spiritual/moral counterpart to visible economic debt.
conceptual_distinctions.repair: Recognition, restitution, changed conduct or restored relation; not automatically monetary payment.
conceptual_distinctions.spiritual_bank: Project metaphor that stores claims, consequences, obligations and generative value.
conceptual_distinctions.mud_stones: Symbolic accumulated harms/residue that contribute to the debt ledger.
